result.summary: Both prior rejections are correctly fixed. executor.py:353 now slices time.localtime(now)[:3] (year, month, day) instead of [:2], and the stamped-row filter uses the same [:3] comparison, so the daily cap correctly resets at midnight (verified by new test test_active_share_cap_resets_per_calendar_day, which checks a switch stamped yesterday doesn't count toward today's cap and today's own cap still triggers after one switch). handoff_scorecard.py by_start() now computes `stamped`/`active_share` inside the per-group loop from that group's own `rows`, not the global lineage, so a group with no handoff stamps correctly reports active_share 0.0 (verified by new test additions in test_handoff_scorecard.py adding T-three/cheap and T-legacy groups with zero switches, both asserting active_share == 0). All originally listed acceptance criteria plus the new test_active_share_cap_resets_per_calendar_day are present and the gate already recorded 0 reds. No new issues introduced by the fix.
